PLAN "12-Week PCOS Body Composition and Insulin Sensitivity (Start 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build muscle and improve insulin sensitivity"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Improve body composition without under-fuelling"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
